notes: Historical revenue and operating income/loss (used as EBIT proxy) and depreciation & amortization are taken from Warner Bros. Discovery FY2025 Form 10-K consolidated statements of operations (figures originally reported in millions, converted to full USD units). ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/336605034/files/doc_earnings/2025/q4/filing/WBD-2026-02-26-10K-Filed-Copy.pdf))

Capex is mapped to 'Purchases of property and equipment' from the FY2025 cash flow statement (outflow magnitudes converted to full USD units). ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/336605034/files/doc_earnings/2025/q4/filing/WBD-2026-02-26-10K-Filed-Copy.pdf))

NWC is approximated as non-cash working capital = (Total current assets − cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − current portion of debt), using FY2025/FY2024 balances and FY2023 balances from the relevant 10-Ks; this is a simplified construction and may differ from any custom NWC definition used in a specific DCF pipeline. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/336605034/files/doc_earnings/2025/q4/filing/WBD-2026-02-26-10K-Filed-Copy.pdf))

Tax/NOL inputs: NOL balance is approximated from 'loss carry-forwards' (federal + state + foreign) disclosed in the FY2025 tax footnote; NOL utilization rate is not explicitly disclosed in the accessible filing content used here, so nol_utilization_pct is set to null. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/336605034/files/doc_earnings/2025/q4/filing/WBD-2026-02-26-10K-Filed-Copy.pdf))

Comps: EV/NTM Revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were not reliably captured from primary/official sources during this run, so the comps multiple fields are set to null (peer identities still provided).

catalysts: Sustained streaming subscriber and engagement traction at Max/discovery+ leading to improved distribution and advertising monetization.
Debt management actions (refinancing/repayment) and any transaction outcomes that change perceived leverage risk.
Content slate execution (renewals and output pacing) improving content economics and reducing volatility in operating profit.
company_overview: Warner Bros. Discovery is a global media and entertainment company creating and distributing branded content across television, film, streaming, and gaming. ([wbd.com](https://www.wbd.com/news/warner-bros-discovery-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Core brands and platforms include HBO, Max, discovery+, CNN, TNT Sports, and Warner Bros. Motion Picture/Television properties. ([wbd.com](https://www.wbd.com/news/warner-bros-discovery-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Financial reporting is presented with distribution, advertising, content, and other revenue components; profitability is driven by operating leverage across these lines. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/336605034/files/doc_earnings/2025/q4/filing/WBD-2026-02-26-10K-Filed-Copy.pdf))
current_context: FY 2025 results: total revenues of $37.3B, Adjusted EBITDA of $8.7B, and free cash flow of $3.1B (FCF impacted by separation/transaction items). ([wbd.com](https://www.wbd.com/news/warner-bros-discovery-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Streaming subscriber base ended Q4 2025 at 131.6M streaming subscribers (+3.5M vs. Q3 2025). ([wbd.com](https://www.wbd.com/news/warner-bros-discovery-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Capital structure: ended FY 2025 with $29.0B of net debt and 3.3x net leverage (per company release). ([wbd.com](https://www.wbd.com/news/warner-bros-discovery-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes a modest revenue stabilization/re-growth profile (low-single-digit growth) as streaming scale supports distribution and content monetization.
Operating margin path improves from FY2025 levels toward a normalized terminal EBIT margin as restructuring benefits and cost discipline flow through.
Sustained-but-contained reinvestment intensity: capex modeled at ~3% of sales to support core streaming content and platform development.
Working capital is modeled as structurally negative (content and payable-linked dynamics), with modest normalization over time.
key_risks: Advertising market softness and/or ad-monetization underperformance at streaming platforms.
Higher-than-modeled content and platform costs that prevent operating margin normalization.
Leverage/interest-rate sensitivity and limited operating cash generation during restructuring periods.
Strategic and transaction execution risk (timing, regulatory approvals, and integration effects).

presentation.subtitle: WBD DCF Valuation Inputs (FY2026E–FY2030E)
valuation_summary: DCF base case uses FY2026–FY2030 margins and reinvestment intensity anchored to historical D&A, capex, and working-capital behavior from recent filings. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/336605034/files/doc_earnings/2025/q4/filing/WBD-2026-02-26-10K-Filed-Copy.pdf))
Terminal value is derived via an exit multiple approach (exit EBITDA multiple = 9.0x) with a 2.0% terminal growth rate, reflecting a maturing media/entertainment cash generation profile.
Bull/bear scenarios apply sober, incremental adjustments to growth and EBIT margin plus discount-rate/terminal assumptions to reflect uncertainty around monetization and leverage.
